+        self.base = self.fixture.accepted
+        self.head = self.fixture.commit({b"docs/new.md": ("100644", b"new\n")})
+        tree = self.fixture.repo.commit(self.head).tree
+        self.synthetic = self.fixture.repo.run("-c", "user.name=Fixture", "-c", "user.email=fixture@example.invalid",
+            "commit-tree", tree, "-p", self.base, "-p", self.head, "-m", "Synthetic").strip().decode()
+        self.fixture.repo.run("update-ref", "refs/heads/main", self.synthetic)
+        self.event_path = self.fixture.root / "event.json"
+        self.event = {"number": 999, "repository": {"full_name": REPOSITORY}, "pull_request": {
+            "head": {"sha": self.head}, "base": {"sha": self.base, "ref": "main", "repo": {"full_name": REPOSITORY}}}}
+        self.env = {"GITHUB_ACTIONS": "true", "GITHUB_REPOSITORY": REPOSITORY,
+                    "GITHUB_SHA": self.synthetic, "GITHUB_REF": "refs/pull/999/merge",
+                    "GITHUB_EVENT_NAME": "pull_request", "GITHUB_EVENT_PATH": str(self.event_path),
+                    "GITHUB_RUN_ID": "1234", "GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT": "1"}
+
+    def capture(self, candidate=None):
+        self.event_path.write_text(json.dumps(self.event), encoding="utf-8")
+        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, self.env):
+            return capture_context(self.fixture.repo, candidate or self.synthetic)
+
+    def assert_context_error(self, callback):
+        with self.assertRaises(HardeningError) as error:
+            callback()
+        self.assertEqual("E_CONTEXT", error.exception.code)
+
+    def test_genuine_pr_positive(self):
+        ctx = self.capture()
+        require_pr_acceptance(ctx, head=self.head, base=self.base, synthetic=self.synthetic)
+        self.assertEqual(self.synthetic, ctx.checked_sha)
+        self.assertEqual("canonical_commit_objects", ctx.scope)
+
+    def test_ci_03_wrong_checkout_context(self):
+        self.assert_context_error(lambda: self.capture(self.head))
+        self.event["pull_request"]["head"]["sha"] = self.base
+        self.assert_context_error(self.capture)
+        self.event["pull_request"]["head"]["sha"] = self.head
+        self.env["GITHUB_REF"] = "refs/heads/main"
+        self.assert_context_error(self.capture)
+
+    def test_previous_head_and_base_reports_rejected_unit_controls(self):
+        # These controls do not discharge the required live CI-04/CI-05 exercises.
+        ctx = self.capture()
+        self.assert_context_error(lambda: require_pr_acceptance(ctx, head=self.base, base=self.base, synthetic=self.synthetic))
+        self.assert_context_error(lambda: require_pr_acceptance(ctx, head=self.head, base=self.head, synthetic=self.synthetic))
+        for field, value in (("repository", "other/repository"), ("accepted_release", "0" * 40), ("run_id", True)):
+            forged = dict(asdict(ctx), **{field: value})
+            self.assert_context_error(lambda: require_pr_acceptance(forged, head=self.head, base=self.base, synthetic=self.synthetic))
+
+    def test_ci_09_manual_not_pr_acceptance(self):
+        self.env.update(GITHUB_EVENT_NAME="workflow_dispatch", GITHUB_REF="refs/heads/maintenance")
+        ctx = self.capture()
+        self.assertEqual("workflow_dispatch", ctx.event)
+        self.assert_context_error(lambda: require_pr_acceptance(ctx, head=self.head, base=self.base, synthetic=self.synthetic))
+        report = self.fixture.root / ".hardening-reports" / "manual-context.json"
+        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, self.env):
+            result = context_cli(["--repo", str(self.fixture.root),
+                                  "--event-file", str(self.event_path), "--report", str(report)])
+        self.assertEqual(1, result)
+        payload = json.loads(report.read_bytes())
+        self.assertEqual("FAIL", payload["status"])
+        self.assertEqual("E_CONTEXT", payload["error_code"])
+
+    def test_push_positive_and_after_binding(self):
+        self.env.update(GITHUB_EVENT_NAME="push", GITHUB_REF="refs/heads/main")
+        self.event.update(ref="refs/heads/main", after=self.synthetic)
+        self.assertEqual("push", self.capture().event)
+        self.event["after"] = self.head
+        self.assert_context_error(self.capture)
+
+    def test_local_cannot_fabricate_ci_event(self):
+        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"GITHUB_ACTIONS": "false"}):
+            ctx = capture_context(self.fixture.repo, self.synthetic)
+            self.assertEqual("local", ctx.event)
+            self.assertEqual(self.synthetic, ctx.checked_sha)
+            self.assert_context_error(lambda: capture_context(self.fixture.repo, self.synthetic, self.event_path))
+            for stale in (self.head, self.base):
+                with self.subTest(stale=stale):
+                    self.assert_context_error(lambda: capture_context(self.fixture.repo, stale))
+            advanced = self.fixture.commit({b"docs/newer.md": ("100644", b"later checkout\n")},
+                                           parent=self.synthetic)
+            self.fixture.repo.run("update-ref", "refs/heads/main", advanced)
+            self.assertEqual(advanced, capture_context(self.fixture.repo, advanced).checked_sha)
+            self.assert_context_error(lambda: capture_context(self.fixture.repo, self.synthetic))

+                        "GIT_AUTHOR_NAME": "F2 fixture", "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL": "fixture@example.invalid",

+    @classmethod

+    @classmethod
+    def raw_git(cls, *args, input=None):
+        command = [cls.git, "--no-replace-objects", "-c", "core.autocrlf=false", "-c", "core.hooksPath=",
+                   "-C", str(cls.root), *args]
+        process = subprocess.run(command, input=input, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+                                 env=cls.env, timeout=30)
+        if process.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError(process.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
+        return process.stdout
+
+    @classmethod
+    def commit_files(cls, files, parent=None):
+        nested = {}
+        for path, (mode, payload) in files.items():
+            node = nested
+            components = path.split(b"/")
+            for component in components[:-1]:
+                node = node.setdefault(component, {})
+            oid = cls.raw_git("hash-object", "-w", "--stdin", input=payload).strip()
+            node[components[-1]] = (mode.encode(), oid)
+
+        def tree(node):
+            records = []
+            for name in sorted(node):
+                value = node[name]
+                if isinstance(value, dict):
+                    mode, kind, oid = b"040000", b"tree", tree(value)
+                else:
+                    mode, oid = value
+                    kind = b"blob"
+                records.append(mode + b" " + kind + b" " + oid + b"\t" + name + b"\0")
+            return cls.raw_git("mktree", "-z", input=b"".join(records)).strip()
+
+        args = ["commit-tree", tree(nested).decode()]
+        if parent:
+            args += ["-p", parent]
+        return cls.raw_git(*args, input=b"F2 isolated fixture\n").strip().decode()

+"""HARDENING.F2: execute the pinned exporter, then compare canonical TeX bytes.
+
+This predicate is independent of preservation. It certifies faithful export,
+not mathematical truth, PDF visual quality, or fresh proof execution.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import threading
+
+from . import policy
+from .reports import HardeningError, run_cli
+
+TEX_PATH = b"release/v0.2.0/output/pdf/Permansson_Research_Companion_v0.2.0.tex"
+INPUT_PATHS = {"builder": b"release/v0.2.0/build_release.py",
+               "verifier": b"release/v0.2.0/verify_release.py",
+               "manuscript": b"release/v0.2.0/manuscript.json"}
+INPUT_NAMES = {"builder": "build_release.py", "verifier": "verify_release.py",
+               "manuscript": "manuscript.json"}
+MAX_OUTPUT = policy.TEX_OUTPUT_LIMIT
+TIMEOUT = policy.TEX_TIMEOUT
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _Reference:
+    """Internal fixture seam; production entry points always use fixed policy."""
+    accepted: str
+    tree: str
+    revision: str
+    input_hashes: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]
+    tex_hash: str
+    tex_size: int
+
+
+def _production_reference():
+    return _Reference(policy.ACCEPTED_RELEASE, policy.ACCEPTED_RELEASE_TREE, policy.RESEARCH_SOURCE,
+                      tuple((key, policy.SHA256_PINS[key]) for key in INPUT_PATHS),
+                      policy.SHA256_PINS["tex"], policy.TEX_EXPECTED_SIZE)
+
+
+def _read_inputs(repo, reference):
+    try:
+        commit = repo.commit(reference.accepted)
+    except HardeningError as exc:
+        raise HardeningError("E_REFERENCE_MISSING", "Accepted exporter commit is unavailable") from exc
+    if commit.tree != reference.tree:
+        raise HardeningError("E_REFERENCE_ID", "Accepted exporter tree disagrees with fixed policy")
+    entries = repo.tree(reference.accepted)
+    inputs = {}
+    for name, path in INPUT_PATHS.items():
+        entry = entries.get(path)
+        if entry is None:
+            raise HardeningError("E_REFERENCE_MISSING", f"Missing accepted export input: {path.decode()}")
+        if entry.object_type != "blob" or entry.mode != "100644":
+            raise HardeningError("E_EXPORT_REFERENCE", f"Accepted export input is not a normal source file: {name}")
+        inputs[name] = repo.blob(entry.oid, limit=MAX_OUTPUT)
+    return inputs
+
+
+def _bounded_worker(command, *, cwd, env, timeout=TIMEOUT, limit=MAX_OUTPUT):
+    """Bound both pipes while reading; kill on overflow rather than buffer it."""
+    try:
+        process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+                                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, close_fds=True)
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise HardeningError("E_DEPENDENCY_MISSING", "Cannot launch isolated Python worker", 3) from exc
+    buffers = {"stdout": bytearray(), "stderr": bytearray()}
+    overflow = threading.Event()
+    reader_errors = []
+
+    def read_pipe(name, stream, budget):
+        try:
+            while True:
+                chunk = stream.read(16384)
+                if not chunk:
+                    break
+                remaining = budget - len(buffers[name])
+                buffers[name].extend(chunk[:max(remaining, 0)])
+                if len(chunk) > remaining:
+                    overflow.set()
+                    process.kill()
+                    break
+        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+            reader_errors.append(str(exc))
+        finally:
+            stream.close()
+
+    readers = [threading.Thread(target=read_pipe, args=("stdout", process.stdout, limit), daemon=True),
+               threading.Thread(target=read_pipe, args=("stderr", process.stderr, 8192), daemon=True)]
+    for reader in readers:
+        reader.start()
+    timed_out = False
+    try:
+        process.wait(timeout=timeout)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        timed_out = True
+        process.kill()
+        process.wait()
+    for reader in readers:
+        reader.join(timeout=5)
+    if any(reader.is_alive() for reader in readers):
+        raise HardeningError("E_COMMAND_TIMEOUT", "Worker output pipes did not close")
+    if timed_out:
+        raise HardeningError("E_COMMAND_TIMEOUT", "Isolated exporter exceeded its time budget")
+    if overflow.is_set():
+        raise HardeningError("E_LIMIT", "Isolated exporter exceeded its stdout/stderr budget")
+    if reader_errors:
+        raise HardeningError("E_EXPORT_REFERENCE", "Could not read isolated exporter output")
+    diagnostic = bytes(buffers["stderr"]).decode("utf-8", "replace")
+    if process.returncode:
+        prefix = "PERMANSSON_TEX_ERROR "
+        if diagnostic.startswith(prefix):
+            try:
+                error = json.loads(diagnostic[len(prefix):])
+                if error.get("code") in {"E_IMPORT_ORIGIN", "E_REFERENCE_MISSING", "E_EXPORT_REFERENCE"}:
+                    raise HardeningError(error["code"], str(error["message"])[:2000])
+            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
+                pass
+        raise HardeningError("E_EXPORT_REFERENCE", "Isolated exporter failed: " + diagnostic[:2000])
+    if diagnostic:
+        raise HardeningError("E_EXPORT_REFERENCE", "Isolated exporter emitted unexpected diagnostics: " + diagnostic[:2000])
+    return bytes(buffers["stdout"])
+
+
+def _render_trusted_inputs(inputs, reference, *, worker=None, timeout=TIMEOUT, cwd=None, environment=None):
+    expected = dict(reference.input_hashes)
+    if set(inputs) != set(INPUT_NAMES):
+        raise HardeningError("E_REFERENCE_MISSING", "Trusted exporter dependency closure is incomplete")
+    for name, data in inputs.items():
+        if len(data) > MAX_OUTPUT:
+            raise HardeningError("E_LIMIT", "Trusted input exceeds export input budget")
+        if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != expected.get(name):
+            raise HardeningError("E_EXPORT_REFERENCE", f"Trusted {name} digest disagrees with fixed policy")
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="permansson-trusted-tex-") as directory:
+        trusted = Path(directory).resolve()
+        for name, filename in INPUT_NAMES.items():
+            (trusted / filename).write_bytes(inputs[name])
+        worker_path = Path(worker).resolve() if worker is not None else Path(__file__).with_name("_tex_worker.py").resolve()
+        command = [sys.executable, "-I", "-S", "-B", str(worker_path), str(trusted), reference.revision,
+                   expected["manuscript"], expected["builder"], expected["verifier"], INPUT_NAMES["manuscript"]]
+        # Isolated interpreter flags are the import boundary. Sanitization also
+        # prevents unrelated startup/debug/encoding settings affecting execution.
+        env = dict(os.environ if environment is None else environment)
+        env = {key: value for key, value in env.items() if not key.upper().startswith("PYTHON")}
+        result = _bounded_worker(command, cwd=str(cwd or trusted), env=env, timeout=timeout)
+    if len(result) != reference.tex_size or hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest() != reference.tex_hash:
+        raise HardeningError("E_EXPORT_REFERENCE", "Trusted export differs from the independently pinned size/digest")
+    return result
+
+
+def render_accepted_tex(repo):
+    reference = _production_reference()
+    return _render_trusted_inputs(_read_inputs(repo, reference), reference)
+
+
+def _compare_tex(repo, candidate, reference):
+    repo.validate_candidate(candidate, accepted_sha=reference.accepted, accepted_tree=reference.tree)
+    expected = _render_trusted_inputs(_read_inputs(repo, reference), reference)
+    entry = repo.tree(candidate).get(TEX_PATH)
+    if entry is None or entry.object_type != "blob" or entry.mode != "100644":
+        raise HardeningError("E_TEX_TYPE", "Candidate TeX must be a committed normal nonexecutable file")
+    actual = repo.blob(entry.oid, limit=MAX_OUTPUT)
+    result = {"scope": "canonical_commit_objects", "expected_sha256": hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest(),
+              "actual_sha256": hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest(), "expected_size": len(expected),
+              "actual_size": len(actual), "equation_records": expected.count(b"\n\\companionEquation{"),
+              "reference_revision": reference.revision,
+              "completed_stages": ["trusted_input_hashes", "isolated_reference_render", "reference_output_pin", "candidate_byte_comparison"]}
+    if actual != expected:
+        offset = next((index for index, pair in enumerate(zip(expected, actual)) if pair[0] != pair[1]), min(len(expected), len(actual)))
+        error = HardeningError("E_TEX_MISMATCH", "Candidate TeX does not exactly reproduce trusted export: " +
+                               json.dumps({**{key: result[key] for key in ("expected_sha256", "actual_sha256", "expected_size", "actual_size")},
+                                           "first_differing_byte": offset}, sort_keys=True))
+        error.details = {**result, "first_differing_byte": offset}
+        raise error
+    return result
+
+
+def compare_tex(repo, candidate):
+    return _compare_tex(repo, candidate, _production_reference())
+
+
+def verify_tex(repo, candidate, event_file=None):
+    from .ci_context import capture_context
+    capture_context(repo, candidate, event_file=event_file)
+    return compare_tex(repo, candidate)
+
+
+def main(argv=None):
+    return run_cli("release-export-integrity", argv, verify_tex)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Privilege-dropped worker; attest isolation before parsing a supplement."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+# A direct script invocation needs only this known source root, never cwd or
+# candidate PYTHONPATH. The launcher has already dropped all root privileges.
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
+
+from verification.integrity.reports import HardeningError, check_report, write_report
+from verification.archive.offline_smoke import isolation_attestation
+from verification.archive.verify_bundle import verify_supplement
+
+
+def main(argv=None):
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--supplement", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--scratch", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--report", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--parent-netns", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--source-repo")
+    parser.add_argument("--source-candidate")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        isolation = isolation_attestation(args.parent_netns)
+        os.environ["PERMANSSON_PARENT_NETNS"] = args.parent_netns
+        details = verify_supplement(args.supplement, args.scratch, require_isolation=True,
+                                    source_repo=args.source_repo, source_candidate=args.source_candidate)
+        details["isolation"] = isolation
+        payload = check_report("archive-reproducibility", details=details,
+                               completed_stages=details["completed_stages"])
+        code = 0
+    except HardeningError as exc:
+        payload = check_report("archive-reproducibility", None, "BLOCKED" if exc.exit_code == 3 else "FAIL", exc)
+        code = exc.exit_code
+    except Exception as exc:
+        payload = check_report("archive-reproducibility", None, "FAIL", HardeningError("E_UNEXPECTED", str(exc)))
+        code = 1
+    write_report(args.report, payload)
+    return code
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Bounded, strict supplement inventories. Checksums do not authenticate publishers."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
+import re
+import stat
+
+from verification.integrity.reports import HardeningError
+
+FORMAT = "Permansson.Hardening.Archive.v1"
+MAX_METADATA = 8 * 1024 * 1024
+MAX_BUNDLE = 256 * 1024 * 1024
+MAX_OBJECT = 128 * 1024 * 1024
+MAX_CLOSURE = 1024 * 1024 * 1024
+MAX_OBJECTS = 200_000
+# Fixed delivered-filesystem budgets, independent of Git object closure.
+# The normal supplement is far below these ceilings.
+MAX_FILES = 2048
+MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 512 * 1024 * 1024
+MAX_DIRECTORIES = 2048
+MAX_DIRECTORY_DEPTH = 128
+SHA = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{40}\Z")
+SHA256 = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}\Z")
+SELF_FILES = {"archive-manifest.json", "archive-manifest.sha256"}
+
+
+def fail(code, message, exit_code=1):
+    raise HardeningError(code, message, exit_code)
+
+
+def stable_json(value):
+    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def digest(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def atomic_json(path, value):
+    path = Path(path)
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + f".{os.getpid()}.tmp")
+    try:
+        with temporary.open("xb") as stream:
+            stream.write(stable_json(value))
+        os.replace(temporary, path)
+    finally:
+        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)

+def strict_json(data, code="E_MANIFEST_FORMAT"):
+    if len(data) > MAX_METADATA:
+        fail("E_LIMIT", "JSON metadata exceeds the fixed 8 MiB budget")

+        result = {}
+        for key, value in rows:
+            if key in result:
+                fail(code, "Duplicate JSON key: " + key)
+            result[key] = value
+        return result
+    try:
+        return json.loads(data.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=pairs,
+                          parse_constant=lambda value: fail(code, "Non-finite JSON number"))
+    except (ValueError, UnicodeError) as exc:
+        fail(code, "Invalid UTF-8 JSON: " + str(exc))

+        fail("E_MANIFEST_FORMAT", "Unsafe delivered path")
+    parts = value.split("/")
+    if any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in parts) or str(PurePosixPath(value)) != value:

+    return value

+    if path.stat().st_size > limit:
+        fail("E_LIMIT", "Delivered file exceeds its size budget: " + str(path))
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        data = stream.read(limit + 1)
+    if len(data) > limit:
+        fail("E_LIMIT", "Delivered file grew beyond its size budget")
+    return data

+            if observed_size > limit:
+                fail("E_LIMIT", "Delivered payload grew beyond its size budget: " + relative)
+            hasher.update(chunk)

+    from verification.integrity.ci_context import capture_context

+        repo = GitRepo(repo_path or ".")
+        target = candidate or repo.run("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()

+def restored_artifact_context(scratch):
+    from verification.integrity.ci_context import capture_context
+    from .create_bundle import ACCEPTED

+        fail("E_CONTEXT", "A historical replay cannot substitute for genuine candidate CI")

+        ipv6 = Path("/proc/net/ipv6_route").read_text().splitlines()
+    except OSError as exc:

+    if os.getuid() == 0 or os.getgid() == 0 or os.getgroups():

+"""Bind the committed publication candidate to the verified canonical supplement."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from io import BytesIO
+from pathlib import Path
+import stat
+import struct
+import zipfile
+import zlib
+
+from verification.integrity.reports import HardeningError
+from .create_bundle import ACCEPTED, ACCEPTED_TREE
+from .manifest import MAX_BUNDLE, MAX_CLOSURE, MAX_METADATA, SELF_FILES, digest, fail, read_bounded, safe_path
+
+SUPPLEMENT_PREFIX = "archival/v0.2.0/supplement-1/"
+ZIP_PATH = "archival/v0.2.0/publication-candidate/Permansson_v0.2.0_archival-supplement-1.zip"
+MAX_PUBLICATION_FILES = 4096
+FIXED_TIME = (2026, 10, 17, 0, 0, 0)
+
+
+def _reject(message):
+    fail("E_PUBLICATION_INTEGRITY", message)
+
+
+def _verify_zip(payload, expected):
+    """Bound classic-ZIP parsing before opening its central directory; never extract."""
+    if len(payload) > MAX_BUNDLE or len(payload) < 22 or payload[-22:-18] != b"PK\x05\x06":
+        _reject("Publication ZIP exceeds budget or lacks an empty-comment classic ZIP end record")
+    _, disk, directory_disk, disk_count, count, size, offset, comment = struct.unpack("<4s4H2LH", payload[-22:])
+    if (disk or directory_disk or comment or count != disk_count or count == 65535
+            or count != len(expected) or count > MAX_PUBLICATION_FILES
+            or offset + size != len(payload) - 22 or not payload.startswith(b"PK\x03\x04")):
+        _reject("Publication ZIP has an unsupported, unbounded or inconsistent directory")
+    # Do not trust the EOCD count before ZipFile allocates its ZipInfo objects.
+    # A repaired end record could conceal many more actual directory entries.
+    cursor, observed, end = offset, 0, offset + size
+    while cursor < end:
+        if cursor + 46 > end or payload[cursor:cursor + 4] != b"PK\x01\x02":
+            _reject("Malformed publication central-directory record")
+        name_size, extra_size, comment_size = struct.unpack_from("<3H", payload, cursor + 28)
+        observed += 1
+        cursor += 46 + name_size + extra_size + comment_size
+        if observed > count or observed > MAX_PUBLICATION_FILES or cursor > end:
+            _reject("Publication central-directory inventory exceeds its declared fixed budget")
+    if cursor != end or observed != count:
+        _reject("Publication central-directory count differs from the end record")
+    try:
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO(payload)) as archive:
+            entries = archive.infolist()
+            if [entry.filename for entry in entries] != sorted(expected) or archive.comment:
+                _reject("Publication ZIP member inventory/order differs from canonical C")
+            local_cursor = 0
+            for entry in entries:
+                name = entry.filename
+                try:
+                    safe_path(name)
+                except HardeningError as exc:
+                    raise HardeningError("E_PUBLICATION_INTEGRITY", "Unsafe publication ZIP member path") from exc
+                content = expected[name]
+                if (entry.orig_filename != name or entry.is_dir() or entry.flag_bits & ~0x800 or entry.create_system != 3
+                        or entry.external_attr >> 16 != stat.S_IFREG | 0o644
+                        or entry.date_time != FIXED_TIME or entry.extra or entry.comment
+                        or entry.compress_type not in {zipfile.ZIP_STORED, zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED}
+                        or entry.file_size != len(content) or entry.header_offset >= offset):
+                    _reject("Publication ZIP member has unsafe metadata or an unexpected size: " + name)
+                if entry.header_offset != local_cursor or local_cursor + 30 > offset:
+                    _reject("Publication local records contain a gap, overlap or invalid offset")
+                local = struct.unpack_from("<4s5H3L2H", payload, local_cursor)
+                filename = name.encode("utf-8" if entry.flag_bits & 0x800 else "cp437")
+                if (local[:5] != (b"PK\x03\x04", entry.extract_version, entry.flag_bits, entry.compress_type, 0)
+                        or local[5] != ((2026 - 1980) << 9 | 10 << 5 | 17)
+                        or local[6:9] != (entry.CRC, entry.compress_size, entry.file_size)
+                        or local[9:] != (len(filename), 0)
+                        or payload[local_cursor + 30:local_cursor + 30 + len(filename)] != filename):
+                    _reject("Publication local metadata differs from its canonical central record")
+                local_cursor += 30 + len(filename) + entry.compress_size
+                if local_cursor > offset:
+                    _reject("Publication compressed member overlaps the central directory")
+                with archive.open(entry) as stream:
+                    actual = stream.read(len(content) + 1)
+                if actual != content:
+                    _reject("Publication ZIP member differs from canonical supplement: " + name)
+            if local_cursor != offset:
+                _reject("Publication ZIP has unreferenced bytes before its central directory")
+    except (zipfile.BadZipFile, zlib.error, RuntimeError, NotImplementedError, OSError, ValueError, EOFError) as exc:
+        raise HardeningError("E_PUBLICATION_INTEGRITY", "Cannot safely read publication ZIP") from exc
+
+
+def validate_committed_publication(repo, candidate, supplement, manifest):
+    """Authority is canonical C, including both manifest files and every inner path."""
+    repo.validate_candidate(candidate, accepted_sha=ACCEPTED, accepted_tree=ACCEPTED_TREE)
+    if repo.run("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip() != candidate:
+        _reject("Publication candidate differs from current checkout HEAD")
+    tree = repo.tree(candidate)
+    prefix = SUPPLEMENT_PREFIX.encode()
+    entries = {path[len(prefix):].decode("utf-8"): entry for path, entry in tree.items() if path.startswith(prefix)}
+    expected_names = {row["path"] for row in manifest["files"]} | SELF_FILES
+    if not entries or len(entries) > MAX_PUBLICATION_FILES or set(entries) != expected_names:
+        _reject("Committed supplement path set differs from the verified delivered inventory")
+    expected, total = {}, 0
+    for name, entry in entries.items():
+        safe_path(name)
+        if entry.object_type != "blob" or entry.mode != "100644":
+            _reject("Committed supplement contains a nonregular or non-0644 path")
+        limit = MAX_BUNDLE if name == "history.bundle" else MAX_METADATA
+        content = repo.blob(entry.oid, limit=limit)
+        total += len(content)
+        if total > MAX_CLOSURE:
+            _reject("Canonical supplement exceeds its aggregate byte budget")
+        if read_bounded(Path(supplement) / name, limit) != content:
+            _reject("Verified supplement filesystem differs from committed C: " + name)
+        expected[name] = content
+    archive, sidecar = tree.get(ZIP_PATH.encode()), tree.get((ZIP_PATH + ".sha256").encode())
+    if any(entry is None or entry.object_type != "blob" or entry.mode != "100644" for entry in (archive, sidecar)):
+        _reject("Committed publication ZIP and checksum must be regular 0644 blobs")
+    payload = repo.blob(archive.oid, limit=MAX_BUNDLE)
+    checksum = repo.blob(sidecar.oid, limit=256)
+    if checksum != (digest(payload) + "  " + Path(ZIP_PATH).name + "\n").encode("ascii"):
+        _reject("Committed publication ZIP checksum differs")
+    _verify_zip(payload, expected)
+    return {"status": "PASS", "scope": "canonical_candidate_objects", "candidate": candidate,
+            "zip_path": ZIP_PATH, "zip_blob": archive.oid, "sidecar_blob": sidecar.oid,
+            "zip_sha256": digest(payload), "zip_bytes": len(payload), "members": len(expected),
+            "canonical_inner_files": len(expected), "verified_filesystem_matches_C": True}

+class Graph:
+    def __init__(self, root):
+        self.root = Path(root)
+        subprocess.run([shutil.which("git"), "-c", "init.templateDir=", "init", "--bare", str(self.root)],
+                       check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
+        self.repo = GitRepo(self.root)
+        self.repo.run("config", "user.name", "Archive fixture")
+        self.repo.run("config", "user.email", "archive@example.invalid")
+        self.t0 = self.tree(b"base\n")
+        self.base = self.commit(self.t0, [], "base")
+        self.t1 = self.tree(b"head\n")
+        self.head = self.commit(self.t1, [self.base], "head")
+        self.synthetic = self.commit(self.t1, [self.base, self.head], "synthetic")
+        self.main = self.commit(self.t1, [self.base, self.head], "main")
+        self.registry = {"refs": [{"ref": REF_PREFIX + name, "commit": oid}
+                                  for name, oid in sorted({"base": self.base, "head": self.head,
+                                                          "synthetic": self.synthetic, "main": self.main}.items())],
+                         "milestones": [{"anchor": "fixture", "head": self.head, "base": self.base,
+                                         "synthetic": self.synthetic, "main": self.main}]}
+
+    def tree(self, payload):
+        blob = self.repo.run("hash-object", "-w", "--stdin", input=payload).strip().decode()
+        return self.repo.run("mktree", input=("100644 blob " + blob + "\tfile.txt\n").encode()).strip().decode()
+
+    def commit(self, tree, parents, message):
+        args = ["commit-tree", tree]
+        for parent in parents:
+            args.extend(["-p", parent])
+        return self.repo.run(*args, input=(message + "\n").encode()).strip().decode()
